      - /usr/bin/helm

    - echo "$GCP_SA_KEY_PRODUCTION" | base64 -d > gcp-key.json
    - gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file=gcp-key.json
    - gcloud components install gke-gcloud-auth-plugin

    - helm repo add --username helm-rails --password $GITLAB_DEPLOY_TOKEN_PASSWORD helm-rails http://mygitlab-dev.ioh.co.id/api/v4/projects/61/packages/helm/stable
    - helm repo update
  script:
    - echo "Deploying to Production"
    - |
      helm upgrade --install --debug ioh-ide-phoenix helm-rails/rails-service --version 0.4.6 --namespace default \
        --set image.tag=$COMMIT_HASH \
        --set externalSecrets.enabled=false \
        --set-file config.env.content=deployment/.env.prod.vars \
        --set-file config.secret.content=deployment/.secret.prod.vars \
        --set dbMigrate.enabled=true \
        --set sidekiqWorker.enabled=true \
        -f deployment/prod-values.yaml \
        --kubeconfig $KUBE_CONFIG_PATH --kube-insecure-skip-tls-verify
  after_script:
    # install curl for slack notifications
    - apk add --no-cache curl
    
    # slack notification - deployment completed/failed
    - |
      if [ "$CI_JOB_STATUS" = "success" ]; then
        curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
          --data "{\"text\":\":white_check_mark: *Production Deployment Completed Successfully*\\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\\n:hash: *Commit:* ${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}\\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
          $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack success notification failed"
      else
        curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
          --data "{\"text\":\":x: *Production Deployment Failed*\\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\\n:hash: *Commit:* ${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}\\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \

  <<: *prod-env
  when: manual
  allow_failure: false
  tags:
    - ide-prod

rollback-approval:
  stage: rollback-approval
  script:
    - 'echo "Rollback approved for tag: $CI_COMMIT_TAG"'
    - 'echo "Previous deployment will be rolled back"'
  <<: *rollback-rules
  <<: *prod-env
  when: manual
  needs:
    - prod-deploy

  image: google/cloud-sdk:alpine
  stage: rollback
  variables:
    <<: *prod-variables
  before_script:

    - '[ -z "$GCP_SA_KEY_PROD" ] && echo "ERROR: GCP_SA_KEY_PROD variable is not set or empty. Please check your GitLab CI/CD settings." && exit 1'
    - echo "$GCP_SA_KEY_PROD" | base64 -d > gcp-key.json
    - gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file=gcp-key.json

    - gcloud container clusters get-credentials $GKE_CLUSTER_NAME_PROD --zone $GKE_ZONE --project $GKE_PROJECT_ID_PROD --internal-ip

    # install helm
    - apk add --no-cache helm

    - helm repo add --username helm-rails --password $GITLAB_DEPLOY_TOKEN_PASSWORD helm-rails http://mygitlab-dev.ioh.co.id/api/v4/projects/61/packages/helm/stable
    - helm repo update
  script:
    - echo "Rolling back deployment"
    - |
      helm rollback ioh-ide-phoenix --namespace default --kubeconfig $KUBE_CONFIG_PATH
    - echo "Rollback completed successfully"
  <<: *rollback-rules
  <<: *prod-env
  allow_failure: false
  tags:
    - docker-in-docker
  needs:
    - rollback-approval
